# Assessment Overview

This document serves as the navigation entry point for the supplementary analysis documents generated as part of the Litemall application assessment. Each document below provides a detailed view of a specific aspect of the application.

## Supplementary Documents

| Document | Description |
|---|---|
| [Architecture Diagram](architecture-diagram.md) | Two-layer architecture visualization: high-level application architecture (layers, data stores, external services) and detailed component relationship diagram (controllers, services, repositories, cross-cutting concerns) |
| [Dependency Map](dependency-map.md) | Visual map of all external dependencies grouped by functional category (web frameworks, database/ORM, security, cloud integrations, API documentation, utilities), with version and compatibility risk analysis |
| [API & Service Contracts](api-service-contracts.md) | Catalog of all REST API endpoints across the WeChat Mini Program API and Admin API, including service catalog, endpoint inventory, DTO contracts, communication patterns, security posture, and service communication sequence diagram |
| [Data Architecture](data-architecture.md) | Database configuration, entity model ER diagram, data ownership boundaries, key repository methods, caching strategy, and data classification and sensitivity analysis |
| [Configuration Inventory](configuration-inventory.md) | Comprehensive inventory of all configuration sources, build and runtime profiles, properties (with defaults and secrets), startup parameters, feature flags, and framework/runtime versions |
| [Business Workflows](business-workflows.md) | Core business domain documentation covering domain entities, service-to-domain mapping, primary workflows (login, order placement, payment, fulfilment, after-sale, scheduled jobs), business rules, order state machine, and validation logic |
